Follow-up to PR [Bare-number citation hook: a link to a pull request or GHI under another item's title is noted](https://github.com/nedschorus/nedschorus/pull/1265). It takes merge-lane-2's non-blocking items 1 and 5 from that PR's last review.

## Item 1: a test for a wrong number listed 11th or later

No test covered a wrong-number link listed 11th or later, past the ten listed hits, so the mutant that looked for a wrong number among the unlisted links survived. The new test writes ten links under wrong titles, then one with a wrong number. It checks that the note counts the eleventh link and has no wrong-number line. The code was already correct.

## Item 5: the three fast-read notes from record `pr-1265-fix-round-2-link-title-notes-2026-10-13-2`

- **"that item":** in the reply note, "If a later reply of yours mentions that item" could mean either item. It now reads "cites the item again", and the agent decides "from your earlier reply".
- **Own words:** a wrong-number link written in the agent's own words was told to take the GitHub title. It is now told to keep the words and make any number in them the number of the item it meant. Root cause: the wrong-number line was written for a link whose text was meant as a title, and the own-words case, which the title lines already handled, was never carried over to it.
- **All wrong numbers:** when every link found has a wrong number, listed or not, the note now leaves out the title instructions, because the wrong-number line would cancel them. Root cause: the note's opening lines were added whole, whatever kinds of hit followed them.
- **The gh command:** the command in the wrong-number line is now `gh issue view <that item's number> --json title --jq .title`, which prints the title alone (checked with PR 1195). Root cause: in PR 1265 the command was written from memory and never run. `--json title` prints `{"title": ...}`, not the title. Each command a note names is now run on ned-box before the note ships, as this round did.

My own fast read of the changed notes, with `triage.md`: `nedlern@ned-box:/home/nedlern/nedschorus-logs/cold-read-records/citation-link-title-follow-up-messages-2026-10-13`.

## Not in this pull request

- **Items 2 and 3**, the escaped-backslash parity, escaped quotes, and the double unescape, are declined. Each has 0 occurrences in the replay corpus. CLAUDE.md's reviewer rule asks for a failure we can cite before adding code that prevents one. If one appears, it shows up as a visible note.
- **Item 4**, a quoted label that begins like an ID prefix: fleet-restart-at-login, the hook's owner, ruled no change. It has 0 occurrences in `docs/**/*.md` on main and in the 1,813 ned-box replies from the last 24 hours.
- **Item 6**, titles GitHub has since renamed: the owner ruled no change.

## Checks

- 177 test cases pass.
- 5 mutants ran in a `-mutation-testing-worktree` copy, and all 5 were killed. The commit message says 6; that is a miscount.
- The affected suites passed: `SUMMARY: 32 passed, 0 failed, 32 total`, from this run's own report in `/tmp/run-all-test-suites-1m174jos` on ned-box.
- branch-conflict-check reported CLEAN.

## Fix-round 1

- **Blocking (1):** the check that leaves out the title lines now looks at every mismatch, listed or not. Before, ten wrong numbers listed and a wrong title unlisted dropped the title lines, while the "more not listed" line still pointed the agent at title mismatches. A test covers that case, and the mutant that checks only the listed links now fails.
- **Blocking (2):** the `Root cause:` lines for the own-words defect and the gh command defect are added above.
- **Non-blocking:** the wrong-number line now stands alone: "the URL may be the part that is wrong, so do not change the link text to fit the URL". It also gives the form to write, `PR <number>, "<title>"`, and says the gh command works for a pull request too. Fast read, with `triage.md`: `nedlern@ned-box:/home/nedlern/nedschorus-logs/cold-read-records/citation-link-title-follow-up-messages-2026-10-13-2`.

## Fix-round 2

- **Blocking, from merge-lane-2's review 5510582056:** fix-round 1 dropped the wrong-number line's override clause in every case, so a note listing both kinds of link contradicted itself. The wrong-number line is now built for its note:
  - **Title lines shown:** the line opens with "the two instruction lines above do not apply to it". Both title lines are named, so the own-words line is covered too.
  - **Title lines left out:** the line stands alone, and in a reply note it carries "This note asks for no correction now." That sentence now comes before the wrong-number instructions.
- **Wider pattern:** three rounds running, the fast read saw one combination of note lines, not all of them.
  - **Tests:** a new test renders the note for every combination: reply and Write; wrong titles only, wrong numbers only, and both; ten or fewer, and more than ten. It pins the key lines of each:
    - the summary first;
    - title lines exactly when a link has a plain wrong title;
    - one wrong-number line, with the override exactly when the title lines are shown;
    - in a reply, "no correction now" exactly once, before its instructions;
    - the "more not listed" line exactly past ten.
  - **Fast read:** one fast read covered all twelve rendered notes together, in one file: `nedlern@ned-box:/home/nedlern/nedschorus-logs/cold-read-records/citation-link-title-all-combinations-2026-10-13`. Two findings were applied: the override names both title lines, and own words with no number stay as written.
- **Non-blocking:** the "All wrong numbers" bullet above is corrected to "every link found … listed or not". In the reply note, "no correction now" now comes first.
- **Checks:**
  - Affected suites, from this run's own SUMMARY line (`/tmp/run-all-test-suites-hp3sfd6z`): 130 passed, 0 failed.
  - 250 cases pass.
  - 5 mutants ran in a `-mutation-testing-worktree` copy, and all 5 were killed: override always, override never, no-correction always, no-correction never, and the title-line check over listed links only.
